 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Navin Sharma  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Ahmad Ali

== == ==============================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SATYAVRAT VERMA

1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned APP.
2. Issue notice to the Opposite Party No. 2 by both modes i.e. registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary post for which requisites etc. must be filed on or before 21-12-2023, failing which the present quashing application shall stand rejected without further reference to the Bench.
3. Put up this case on 18-03-2024.
4.

In the meantime, the order dated 19-12-2016 passed by Sri Hareram, learned Judicial Magistrate 1st class, Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.57553 of 2017(2) dt.12-12-2023 Masaurhi, Patna in connection with Complaint Case No. 449(c) of 2016, whereby cognizance of offences under Section 498A and 323 of the IPC has been taken, shall remain stayed.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioners are Mother-in-law, Father-in-law and Brother-in-law (Devar) of the OP No. 2.

It is next submitted that whenever any dispute arises in between the husband and the wife, the entire family members are implicated in a mechanical manner with general and omnibus allegations in order to coerce the husband into submission.
Learned counsel further submits that till date the stage of the case from the stage of the cognizance has not changed.

(Satyavrat Verma, J) SUMIT/-
